My mom was Welsh and she learned to cook by throwing things in a pot and boiling them until they were mush. She gradually improved her technique and passed along this recipe to me.

Potato & Leek Soup with Pancetta

Ingredients:

  • 1 pound leeks

  • 3 oz pancetta, sliced and diced into 1/4" squares

  • 2 Tblsp butter

  • 1 medium onion, diced

  • 3 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1" cubes

  • 3 cups +/- chicken stock

  • 1 bay leaf

  • 1/2 cream

  • 1 tsp salt

  • 1/2 tsp white pepper

  • 1/4 cup grated parmasan cheese

  • 1/4 tsp nutmeg, grated - full disclosure - I hate nutmeg and have never made the soup with it - YMMV

Directions:

  • Rinse the leeks and remove the root ends and any dirty, damaged outer leaves

  • Split the leeks lengthwise in half, then cut the halves into 1/4" slices

  • Clean the slices in water (a small colander is a big help) and drain

  • In a large, heavy-bottomed soup pot, brown the pancetta in the butter (about 3 minutes)

  • Add the onion and cook until browned (about 3 to 5 minutes)

  • Add the potatoes and leeks and cook - stirring frequently - until the leeks are soft (about 10 minutes)

  • Add the stock (enough to cover the ingredients) and the bay leaf and simmer until the potatoes are cooked (about 45 minutes)

  • Add the cream, salt, pepper and nutmeg (yuck) and stir, adjusting to taste

  • Stir in cheese and serve
Potato and Leek Soup with Pancetta (Recipe)
